columns.name: number_of_professors
columns.description: Number of professors teaching the course, replace NULL values with 0. Professor refers to professor = 1 in the person table.

columns.name: number_of_professors_not_faculty
columns.description: Number of professors teaching the course who are not faculty, replace NULL values with 0. Faculty refers to hasposition <> '0' in the person table.

columns.name: number_of_professors_faculty
columns.description: Number of professors teaching the course who are faculty, replace NULL values with 0. Faculty refers to hasposition <> '0' in the person table.

columns.name: taught_by_more_than_4_people
columns.description: Set to 1 if the course is taught by more than 4 people, otherwise, set to 0

columns.name: taught_by_the_advisors
columns.description: Set to 1 if the course is taught by the advisors who gave advice to student, otherwise, set to 0
